items.exactArtifactRequired: Redacted provider/payment smoke artifact with timestamp, environment, and non-sensitive transaction/status proof.
items.acceptableEvidenceFormat: Markdown or JSON packet with screenshots/log snippets redacted for provider IDs, user IDs, and tokens.
items.whatItProves: Provider/payment path works in the intended deployed environment.
items.whatItDoesNotProve: It does not prove source validators or local mocks are deployed runtime proof.
items.nextExactAction: Attach redacted provider smoke artifact after operator-run production or staging smoke.

items.exactArtifactRequired: Route smoke packet for critical user, creator, admin, and API surfaces from deployed environment.
items.acceptableEvidenceFormat: Redacted status matrix with route, role, timestamp, expected status class, and evidence link.
items.whatItProves: Deployed runtime routes respond as expected.
items.whatItDoesNotProve: It does not prove provider billing or payment settlement.
items.nextExactAction: Run deployed smoke and attach redacted route matrix.

items.exactArtifactRequired: Admin truth sample packet using the redaction schema.
items.acceptableEvidenceFormat: JSON or Markdown packet with hashed IDs and no raw email, provider IDs, chat content, storage paths, tokens, or private URLs.
items.whatItProves: Admin summaries can reflect real production/sample truth without exposing sensitive data.
items.whatItDoesNotProve: It does not prove external billing review.
items.nextExactAction: Attach redacted admin truth sample packet.

items.exactArtifactRequired: External billing review note for Cloud Run/App Hosting, Firestore, BigQuery/export, Cloud SQL/Data Connect, and AI surfaces.
items.acceptableEvidenceFormat: Operator-signed review note with billing console screenshots or exported summaries redacted for account details.
items.whatItProves: Cost risk has external billing evidence.
items.whatItDoesNotProve: It does not prove product correctness or runtime smoke.
items.nextExactAction: Complete external billing review and attach redacted evidence.

items.exactArtifactRequired: Final visual QA packet for major user, creator, and admin surfaces.
items.acceptableEvidenceFormat: Checklist with screenshots or recordings and explicit pass/fail notes per surface.
items.whatItProves: Human-visible UI is acceptable after source closure.
items.whatItDoesNotProve: It does not prove provider or billing status.
items.nextExactAction: Run operator-final visual QA and attach packet.

items.exactArtifactRequired: Manual production smoke checklist with timestamp, environment, role, and result.
items.acceptableEvidenceFormat: Markdown checklist or JSON status packet.
items.whatItProves: Critical flows were manually exercised in production or approved staging.
items.whatItDoesNotProve: It does not prove source-only validators are runtime proof.
items.nextExactAction: Run manual production smoke after automated blockers stay closed.
